title: Michael Levin's planaria regeneration and bioelectric experiments

tellings.quote: so Mike Leven has this wonderful set of work for example with pleneria the pleneria reproduce by cutting themselves in half

plain: A biologist named Mike Levin has done experiments on planaria, small flatworms that reproduce by cutting themselves in half and regrowing the missing parts, and has studied the electrical signals in their bodies that guide this regrowth. The cognitive scientist Donald Hoffman describes this "wonderful set of work" to Michels. He uses it to suggest that living bodies are shaped by something beyond genes alone.
